dedupe_keys.name: 976 alea mouvements de terrain atlas des risques

description: 976 Aléa mouvements de terrain (Atlas des risques) is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Area exposed to the hazard of terrain movements (land slide and/or block drops), shown on the hazard map used for the analysis of the risk of terrain movements. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "976 Alea Field Movements (Atlas of Risks)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include 3_A01_Public, Atlas des risques, mouvement de terrain, 2_A01_DEAL, IAL, Aléa. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
